thread:
Rafi: Starting a staged rollout for v3.4.2 -> 8% traffic on /generate. Change window 2026-04-10 01:00 UTC. Deploy-bot will post the plan.

deploy-bot: Rollout initiated: release=v3.4.2 rollout=staged traffic=8% route=/generate id=r-1767899999
```
kubectl apply -f rollouts/r-1767899999.yaml
deployctl rollout start --release v3.4.2 --canary 8 --route /generate
```

SRE-bot: Running baseline checks: p50, p95, p99, 5xx, mem RSS, kv-cache hitrate. Alerts will appear here.

June: Obs request: also track tokenization error rate and generation truncations for long prompts (>4k tokens). Dash link: https://dash.redwood/rollouts/r-1767899999

Lin: Pinned route binding to model v3.4.2 and set runtime flag: quantize_inference=false for canary. Added release notes PR.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic applied. State=HEALTHY. Monitoring window 12m. Will surface signals.

monitor-bot: SIGNAL r-1767899999: p95 +22ms (3m), 5xx=0.05%, kv-cache miss +2%. No allocation errors yet.

June: Minor blip, ok to continue. Watch tokenization error rate.

Rafi: Stop conditions: immediate stop if 5xx >0.6% for 3m OR p95 delta >150ms for 5m OR tokenization_err >0.3% OR any "kvcache: eviction stalled"/"malloc failed" logs. Agree?

Lin: +1. Also trigger manual stop if generation length truncation increases >2x baseline.

monitor-bot: ALERT r-1767899999: tokenization_err = 0.4% (2m). Top log: "tokenizer: invalid byte sequence" on pod llm-gen-3.4.2-canary-2. Logs: https://logs.redwood/rollouts/r-1767899999

Nora: That's over the tokenization threshold. Recommending stop. Preparing rollback steps: pin route back to v3.4.1, drain canary pods, tag image as quarantined.

June: Manual STOP request from obs. Please execute rollback and preserve heap + tokenizer dumps for triage.

deploy-bot: STOP requested by @June. Executing rollback actions:
```
route set /generate --version=3.4.1
scale deployment llm-gen-v3.4.2 --replicas=0
kubectl annotate deployment llm-gen-v3.4.2 quarantined-by=obs-1767899999
collect-logs --tags r-1767899999 --artifacts=tokenizer-dump,heap-dump
```

Rafi: Rollback confirmed. Opening tracker R-5019 for tokenizer regression investigation. Will include failing inputs and tokenizer dumps.

Lin: Updating release notes: "Rollback v3.4.2 -> v3.4.1 due to tokenization errors in canary. Reverted route and quarantined image." Tagging: rollback, tokenizer, canary.

SRE-bot: Rollback complete. Route now -> v3.4.1. Canary pods scaled down. State=ROLLED_BACK.

Nora: Quick sync scheduled 2026-04-10 01:30 UTC to review tokenizer failing corpus and allocator traces. Owners: @Lin, @June.

Rafi: Thanks all for the quick stop. We'll rerun tests against extended tokenization corpus before reattempt. :rocket:
